pr_title: drivers: rtc: stm32: Fixes RTC issues related to device runtime pm (previous pr #62910)
pr_body:
@erwango @FRASTM 
(I made some mistakes when I was updating the old PR and created this new one)

When device runtime pm is enabled, Backup Domain protection is active most of the time. RTC driver need this protection to be disabled in order to set the time or calibration. Commit in this PR disables the protection in set time and set calibration functions.
In addition, another commit fixes the recently added WAIT macro which makes the set time and set calibration functions nonworking when device runtime is enabled.

I divided the original commit into 3 commits as @faloj suggested.

Fixes: https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/62843

issue_context.title: drivers: rtc: stm32: It's not possible to set the time when device runtime pm is enabled and LSE is enabled.
comments:
> My suggested fix is to disable backup domain protection in rtc_stm32_set_time, I can prepare a PR.

If you do so, please additionally fix `drivers/rtc/rtc_ll_stm32.c`.

Note:
I had a look to `LL_PWR_EnableBkUpAccess()/LL_PWR_DisableBkUpAccess()` calls and there is a more global issue on this:
- Disable Bckup access is not called in `set_up_fixed_clock_sources` in `drivers/clock_control/clock_stm32_ll_h7.c`. This has to be fixed for consistency across series.
- 2 drivers are implemented with the assumption that Back up Domain access is enabled: 
   - `drivers/bbram/bbram_stm32.c`:  Disable/Enable should be added around the write function. @semihalf-duda-patryk I'm surprised you've never faced any issue related to this point.
   - `soc/arm/st_stm32/common/stm32_backup_sram.c`: It is mapping backup RAM as a RAM region accessible to the system. I don't see other option than enabling access globally and never disabling access. This should be controlled by a Kconfig option and a STM32 API should be added to control access disabling.

This issue has been marked as stale because it has been open (more than) 60 days with no activity. Remove the stale label or add a comment saying that you would like to have the label removed otherwise this issue will automatically be closed in 14 days. I fixed this issue. Does it look correct now?
